001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
010import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
011import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
012
013/**
014 *
015 * @author jimmy
016 */
017public class PropTransitiveCard extends Propagator<Variable> {
018
019    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
020
021    private final SetVar set;
022    private final IntVar[] cards;
023
024    public PropTransitiveCard(SetVar set, IntVar[] cards) {
025        super(buildArray(set, cards), PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, false);
026        this.set = set;
027        this.cards = cards;
028    }
029
030    private static Variable[] buildArray(SetVar set, IntVar[] cards) {
031        Variable[] array = new Variable[cards.length + 2];
032        array[0] = set;
033        array[1] = set.getCard();
034        System.arraycopy(cards, 0, array, 2, cards.length);
035        return array;
036    }
037
038    @Override
039    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
040        ISetIterator iter = set.getLB().iterator();
041        while (iter.hasNext()) {
042            int i = iter.nextInt();
043            if (i < 0 || i >= cards.length) {
044                fails();
045            } else {
046                set.getCard().updateLowerBound(cards[i].getLB(), this);
047                cards[i].updateUpperBound(set.getCard().getUB(), this);
048            }
049        }
050    }
051
052    @Override
053    public ESat isEntailed() {
054        ISetIterator iter = set.getLB().iterator();
055        while (iter.hasNext()) {
056            int i = iter.nextInt();
057            if (i < 0 || i >= cards.length || cards[i].getLB() > set.getCard().getUB()) {
058                return ESat.FALSE;
059            }
060        }
061        return isCompletelyInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
062    }
063
064    @Override
065    public String toString() {
066        return "transitiveCard(" + Arrays.toString(vars) + ")";
067    }
068}
